description:
## Scope
Wire backend/backend_opts through agent.ex macros/config, request.ex payload construction, relevant signal schemas, plugin configuration/default maps, actions/reasoning/run_strategy.ex allowlists, all strategy configuration builders, directives, child workers and CLI adapters with explicit option forwarding. Preserve field presence during validation/default application rather than letting defaults mask request overrides.
Resolve Ref once at the appropriate request/run boundary and carry it across process boundaries. Support app, agent, standalone runtime, plugin/action and request scopes. Same-module options shallow-merge; switching module resets inherited options. Concurrent runs must not mutate Application env or depend on process-local selection.
Separate alias expansion and backend validation across all strategies. Custom/local references cannot flow into ReqLLM.model or LLMDB. Existing atom aliases and default-backend input forms remain compatible; custom native atoms may be alias values/explicit references. Per-turn model transformer behavior uses the fixed selected backend.
Migrate reasoning/chain_of_thought/worker/strategy.ex: it currently starts streaming, directly reduces stream_response.stream, summarizes chunks and retrieves StreamResponse.usage. Replace with portable stream consumption while preserving sequence numbers, content/reasoning, usage, terminal events and cancellation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests exercise application defaults, agent overrides, plugin/action defaults and request overrides end to end.
- Every strategy/child worker sees selected backend and effective model.
- Two simultaneous runs using different backends remain isolated.
- Model alias/local reference tests run without ReqLLM model APIs.
- CoT worker consumes custom stream and preserves events/result/usage behavior.

## Suggested commit
feat(runtime): propagate backend configuration across strategies

comments.text: Propagated backend/backend_opts through Request payload, Jido.AI.Agent + strategy-agent macros, plugin state/schema, RunStrategy scopes (app/plugin/runtime/request precedence), CLI adapters, CoT and other strategy config/directives. CoT worker consumes portable Stream and carries response usage; two custom backend concurrent CoT runs tested. ReAct Config now resolves/fingerprints custom model without ReqLLM, default legacy fingerprint fixture still passes; ReAct Strategy stores backend_ref, but ReActRunner execution and request-time transformer selection remain .6. Full stable suite: 31 doctests + 2507 tests, zero failures (1 excluded); focused application default/plugin/alias/concurrency tests pass; format and warnings-as-errors compile checked. One transient unrelated ReAct timing test failure was rerun successfully and did not recur in full suite.

title: Propagate backend configuration through requests, plugins and strategies
